content.text: Which statement is most correct? Choices: A. The person can put the screw in a bin with two black dividers if they lower their body. B. The person can put the screw in the bin directly in front of the person if the right hand is moved forward and to the right. C. There are at least three bins with two black dividers visible in the view. D. None of the above. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
